From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From en- +‎ graxa +‎ -ar.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): (careful pronunciation) /ẽ.ɡɾaˈʃa(ʁ)/ [ẽ.ɡɾaˈʃa(h)], (natural pronunciation) /ĩ.ɡɾaˈʃa(ʁ)/ [ĩ.ɡɾaˈʃa(h)]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): (careful pronunciation) /ẽ.ɡɾaˈʃa(ʁ)/ [ẽ.ɡɾaˈʃa(h)], (natural pronunciation) /ĩ.ɡɾaˈʃa(ʁ)/ [ĩ.ɡɾaˈʃa(h)]
    • (São Paulo) IPA(key): (careful pronunciation) /ẽ.ɡɾaˈʃa(ɾ)/, (natural pronunciation) /ĩ.ɡɾaˈʃa(ɾ)/
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): (careful pronunciation) /ẽ.ɡɾaˈʃa(ʁ)/ [ẽ.ɡɾaˈʃa(χ)], (natural pronunciation) /ĩ.ɡɾaˈʃa(ʁ)/ [ĩ.ɡɾaˈʃa(χ)]
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): (careful pronunciation) /ẽ.ɡɾaˈʃa(ɻ)/, (natural pronunciation) /ĩ.ɡɾaˈʃa(ɻ)/
 
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ẽ.ɡɾaˈʃaɾ/, /ẽ.ɡɾɐˈʃaɾ/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ẽ.ɡɾaˈʃaɾ/, /ẽ.ɡɾɐˈʃaɾ/
    • (Southern Portugal) IPA(key): /ẽ.ɡɾaˈʃa.ɾi/, /ẽ.ɡɾɐˈʃa.ɾi/

  • Hyphenation: en‧gra‧xar

Verb

[edit]

engraxar (first-person singular present engraxo, first-person singular preterite engraxei, past participle engraxado)

  1. to grease, lubricate
  2. to polish
